name: echo water lilies
description: Proposal after Claude Monet, Bridge over a Pond of Water Lilies (1899), 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x as the pond's frog, sitting on the biggest lily pad with its legs folded), under a pale green arched footbridge with posts and a top rail in front of dense green foliage, the dark green pond streaked with drifting pale light, lily pads and pink flowers: a drop falls from under the bridge on the left and flat rings spread while its eyes follow, it sinks to gather and hops straight up with its legs out and its eyes wide, lands with the pad dipping and rings spreading round it and its eyes shut happy, then a second drop lands on the right; judge whether it reads at a glance as the painting, whether the hop reads as a frog's, and whether the rings read as water at 12 px cells.
